subject: CareTap Health — Sprint 0 intake, owners & quickstart checklist
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@caretap.health>, Jim Brown <jim.brown@caretap.health>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CareTap Health — Sprint 0 intake, owners & quickstart checklist

Team — quick handoff after signed SOW. CareTap inked the contract yesterday and wants a fast Sprint 0 next week to validate integration points and confirm go-live scope. High-level details: 

- Customer: CareTap Health (payer-integrations, clinical workflows)
- Contracted start: 2027-01-04 (SOW start)
- Target go-live (phase 1): 2027-02-28
- SKU: Dedicated + Private VPC (2 reserved GPU nodes), monthly commit
- Billing: Net 30 starting 2027-01-01 per SOW
- Security: they require SOC2 evidence (we have copy attached) and an initial KMS key exchange for private deployment

Key stakeholders (from customer): Maya Patel (PM), Jim Brown (Procurement). On our side: Aditya (AE), Stephanie (Customer Success), Vivek (Implementation lead), Chloe (Solutions engineer), Tessa (Delivery manager).

Immediate asks for Sprint 0 (please confirm owners/ETA):
1) Integration checklist validation (internal SE + customer devs) — expected by 12/06
2) VPC networking questionnaire & KMS plan — expected by 12/08
3) Data migration feasibility (sample dataset + retention policy) — customer to share sample by 12/10
4) Kickoff meeting scheduling (1 hour) — propose 12/07 or 12/08

I've attached the signed SOW (CareTap_SOW_v3.pdf) and a starting integration checklist (CTH_integration_checklist.xlsx). Maya/Jim — please confirm the internal dev names and whether 12/07 works for kickoff.

Thanks — Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: CareTap_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, signed), CTH_integration_checklist.xlsx (Excel)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@caretap.health>, Jim Brown <jim.brown@caretap.health>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CareTap Health — Sprint 0 intake, owners & quickstart checklist

Thanks Aditya — congrats team. Quick clarifying Qs before I assign a CSM owner and schedule: 

- Is the SOW's milestone-based acceptance tied to specific latency/throughput SLOs? I want to capture any SLA obligations in our runbook.
- The private VPC ask: are they requesting HSM-backed KMS or standard cloud KMS? That changes the procurement checklist.

I propose Stephanie Nguyen (myself) take primary CSM ownership for onboarding coordination; Chloe to lead technical integration validation during Sprint 0; Vivek to own deployment orchestration and infra provisioning. Tessa — can you lead the kickoff scheduling and add an internal pre-kickoff sync (30m) with the team on 12/06?

Maya/Jim — ping if any of the dates above conflict. We also recommend a short pre-kickoff Doc (3–4 slides) covering scope, acceptance criteria, security checklist and escalation contacts — I'll draft and share by EOD 12/02.

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: CareTap Health — Sprint 0 intake, owners & quickstart checklist

Thanks Steph — quick answers inline: 

- SLOs: Phase 1 acceptance requires 95th percentile latency under 300ms for 2k rps test window and a functional pass on the core inference endpoints. I'll add the exact wording from the SOW to the kickoff doc.
- KMS: They asked for cloud KMS with customer-managed keys (CMK) — not HSM. Procurement flagged that as "customer-managed" rather than Redwood-managed.

I'll confirm the customer's dev contacts today. For kickoff, 12/07 10am PT works for Maya and their team; Jim can set the procurement pre-call earlier if needed.

Attaching the onboarding playbook we typically use for Sprint 0 — Redwood_Onboarding_Playbook.pdf. Steph, feel free to reuse any slides.

Aditya

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@caretap.health>, Jim Brown <jim.brown@caretap.health>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CareTap Health — Sprint 0 intake, owners & quickstart checklist

Assigning owners and first milestones from implementation side. Stephanie — confirming you as CSM lead. Chloe — you own integration validation. I'll take deployment orchestration and infra provisioning. Detailed assignments below: 

- Stephanie Nguyen (CSM): primary customer-facing for timelines, success criteria, exec escalations. Deliverable: Kickoff slides + 30/60/90-day plan by 12/02 EOD.
- Chloe Martin (SE): run integration checklist, validate sample payloads, API contract sign-off. Deliverable: Integration validation report by 12/10.
- Vivek Kulkarni (Impl Lead): provision VPC, coordinate KMS CMK exchange, schedule internal infra build on 12/13. Deliverable: Infra readiness playbook by 12/12.
- Tessa Morgan (Delivery): schedule all meetings and own timeline tracking in Asana.

Risks & mitigation: 
- Network peering windows: customer infra team needs to open IPs; request for list by 12/06 — Chloe to push the checklist.
- Data sharing: customer wants sample dataset; ensure we redact PHI and validate retention match SOW (Chloe + Stephanie).

I will create an implementation folder in SharePoint and drop the infra templates + provisioning scripts. Link: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/implementations/CTH/kickoff-notes (shared in metadata).

I'll hold a 30-min internal pre-kickoff on 12/06 09:00 PT. Tessa please send calendar invites.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Implementations, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Appreciate the speedy turnaround. Looking forward to the kickoff and the Sprint 0 plan.
